::: {.callout-tip}
## Welcome

This site documents two companion R packages with Rust backends:

- [**masreml**](https://github.com/bowo1698/masreml) — REML-based mixed models, BLUP/GBLUP/GWABLUP, GWAS, cross-validation, threshold models for binary traits.
- [**masbayes**](https://github.com/bowo1698/masbayes) — Bayesian genomic prediction (BayesA, BayesR).

Both packages support **SNP** and **microhaplotype** genotypes natively.
:::

## Quick start

```r
# install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("bowo1698/masreml")
devtools::install_github("bowo1698/masbayes")
```

## Data formats

The packages accept **SNP genotypes** (VCF or dosage matrix), **microhaplotype calls**,
**phenotypes** (continuous and binary), and **pedigree**. See [Input Data](input-data/index.qmd)
for full schemas, plus a fully-worked [demo dataset](demo-data/index.qmd) you can
download and reproduce every result on this site with.
